exposure: ever missing a dose of contraceptive method
need for privacy when using a method
outcome: sustained use of modern contraceptives (continual use of the same method for 2 or more years)
cohort: 397 women of reproductive age (15-49 years) residing in the Mfantseman municipality.
finding: The study found that 39.8% of participants were sustained users of modern contraceptives, with missing doses, birth goals, the need for privacy, and socio-economic reasons identified as key motivations for sustained use.
cross-section timing: A cross-sectional survey was conducted at an unspecified time to assess current motivations for sustained contraceptive use.
